passage.text: These are the rules for our shared apartment.
passage.reading: ðiːz ər ðə ˈruːlz fər aʊr ˈʃɛrd əˈpɑːrtmənt.

passage.text: Put a label with your name on your food in the fridge.
passage.reading: ˈpʊt ə ˈleɪbəl wɪð jʊr ˈneɪm ɑːn jʊr ˈfuːd ɪn ðə ˈfrɪdʒ.

passage.text: Do your dishes after every meal.
passage.reading: ˈduː jʊr ˈdɪʃɪz ˈæftər ˈɛvri ˈmiːl.

passage.text: We take turns cleaning the bathroom and the kitchen.
passage.reading: wiː ˈteɪk ˈtɜːrnz ˈkliːnɪŋ ðə ˈbæθruːm ənd ðə ˈkɪtʃən.

passage.text: Quiet hours are from ten at night to seven in the morning.
passage.reading: ˈkwaɪət ˌaʊərz ər frəm ˈtɛn ət ˈnaɪt tə ˈsɛvən ɪn ðə ˈmɔːrnɪŋ.

passage.text: Visitors are welcome, but please tell your roommate first.
passage.reading: ˈvɪzɪtərz ər ˈwɛlkəm, bʌt ˈpliːz ˈtɛl jʊr ˈruːmmeɪt ˈfɜːrst.

passage.text: Visitors can't stay overnight on weekdays.
passage.reading: ˈvɪzɪtərz ˈkænt ˈsteɪ ˌoʊvərˈnaɪt ɑːn ˈwiːkdeɪz.

passage.text: Let's keep our home happy and clean!
passage.reading: ˈlɛts ˈkiːp aʊr ˈhoʊm ˈhæpi ənd ˈkliːn!
